commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
WORK="$(mktemp -d /tmp/bloomml-ipo-doc-freeze.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --branch main https://github.com/MichalMatu/bloomml.git "$WORK/source"
cd "$WORK/source"
EXPECTED="147211350ae646ef5e78686852dd5f49546c307d"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
echo "EXACT_MAIN_SHA|$EXPECTED"
git diff --check c4bf62cf70b5197f5b19906cf48175a75719785e HEAD
echo "DIFF_CHECK|PASS"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path.cwd()
docs=['docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md','docs/CONFIGURATION_FLOW.md','docs/PROJECT_ROADMAP.md','docs/NEXT_CHAT.md','docs/README.md','docs/ARCHITECTURE.md','docs/PRODUCT_DIRECTION.md','docs/HISTORY.md','docs/CHANGELOG.md','docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-bloomml-documentation-freeze-handoff.md']
assert all((root/p).is_file() for p in docs), 'missing docs'
next_chat=(root/'docs/NEXT_CHAT.md').read_text()
status=(root/'docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md').read_text()
roadmap=(root/'docs/PROJECT_ROADMAP.md').read_text()
checkpoint=(root/'docs/checkpoints/2026-11-07-bloomml-documentation-freeze-handoff.md').read_text()
for doc in (next_chat,status,roadmap,checkpoint):
  assert '/dev/cu.usbserial-120' in doc
  assert 'ClosedIpoActivationGate' in doc
assert 'ABSENT' in next_chat and 'izolacj' in next_chat.lower()
assert 'H0' in roadmap and 'H1' in roadmap and 'H2' in roadmap and 'H3' in roadmap
assert 'CROWPANEL BUILD PASS' in status
assert 'make test-ipo' in checkpoint
assert 'ClosedIpoActivationGate' in (root/'src/climate/ClimateV6RealInputRuntime.cpp').read_text()
assert 'ipo_nvs_journal_tests' in (root/'test/host/CMakeLists.txt').read_text()
for p in docs:
  text=(root/p).read_text()
  assert '\u00a7' not in text, (p,'unrendered placeholder')
  for target in re.findall(r'(?<!!)\[[^]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
    if target.startswith(('http://','https://','#','mailto:')): continue
    target=target.split('#',1)[0].strip()
    if target:
      assert (root/p).parent.joinpath(target).exists(), (p,target)
print('LINKS_AND_RESUME_INVARIANTS|PASS')
PY
CHANGED="$(git diff --name-only c4bf62cf70b5197f5b19906cf48175a75719785e HEAD)"
printf '%s\n' "$CHANGED" | grep -v '^docs/' && { echo "NON_DOC_CHANGE|FAIL"; exit 2; } || true
echo "DOCS_ONLY_DIFF|PASS"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "CLEAN_WORKTREE|PASS"
